title.narrative: International Counterproliferation Program (ICP): International Dual-Use Investigations

description.narrative: ICP delivered the International Dual-Use Investigations Course to 24 tactical-to mid-level officials from Sate Border Guard Services (SBS), Ministry of Emergency Situations (MES), and State Customs Service of Kyrgyzstan. Participants reviewed techniques used to pursue transnational investigations enabling interagency coordination for a dual-use investigations. Participants lacked experience and background knowledge of investigation fundamentals utilized by the government of Kyrgyzstan and requested participation of the prosecutors from the State Committee for National Security and members of licensing department from the Ministry of Economy.

title.narrative: International Counterproliferation Program (ICP): WMD Border Security and Interdiction (BSI) Course

description.narrative: The BSI Course was delivered to 27 tactical-to-mid level officials from the State Border Guard Services (SBS), Ministry of Emergency Situations (MES), and Customs of Kyrgyzstan. The course addressed the importance of border security in the interdiction of WMD and other contraband and the importance of a viable border interdiction strategy and stressed the necessity of effective risk management through interagency cooperation.
